verdict.rationale: Cline is itself a coding agent (editor extension/CLI), and the evidence only shows it acting as an MCP *client* consuming external MCP servers (cline-docs-16, cline-gh-2) — not exposing itself as an MCP server for other agents to connect to. Per the agent-role rule, serving-as-MCP-server is a different axis than being an MCP-consuming agent, so this story does not apply.
